title: Weird hit rate
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: Weird-word stories reach 10 or more points more often than other stories, so the lead is not a few outliers.
expect: Share of stories with 10 or more points. If true, the weird-word share is at least 1.3x the share for other stories (1.1x weak, 0.9x or below refutes).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
